spec.description: Job-based reindex monitoring dashboard

spec.title: Status
spec.description: Current status of the selected job. Uses Lookback variable to find job data, independent of dashboard time range.

spec.title: Started
spec.description: When the job started execution. Uses Lookback variable, shows actual job start time regardless of dashboard time range.

spec.title: Ended
spec.description: When the job finished execution. Uses Lookback variable, shows actual job end time regardless of dashboard time range.

spec.title: Duration
spec.description: How long the job ran. Uses the job status gauge (1=running) to pick the formula: while running it shows elapsed time so far (now - start); once finished it shows end - start. Relying on status (instead of whether end_time exists) avoids picking up the PREVIOUS run's stale end time when the same jobId is rerun. Uses Lookback variable, independent of dashboard time range.

spec.title: Age
spec.description: How long ago the job finished (now - end time). The metric alfresco_reindex_job_end_time is epoch *milliseconds* (System.currentTimeMillis), so we divide the delta by 1000 to get *seconds*, which is what the dtdurations unit expects. Uses Lookback variable, independent of dashboard time range.

spec.title: Total Read
spec.description: Total nodes read from database. Uses dashboard time range - adjust time picker to zoom in/out.

spec.title: Filtered
spec.description: Nodes filtered/skipped during processing. Uses dashboard time range - adjust time picker to zoom in/out.

spec.title: Metadata
spec.description: Metadata indexing success/failure counts. Uses dashboard time range - adjust time picker to see full job or specific time window.

spec.title: Content
spec.description: Content indexing success/failure counts. Uses dashboard time range - adjust time picker to see full job or specific time window.

spec.title: Path
spec.description: Path indexing success/failure counts. Uses dashboard time range - adjust time picker to see full job or specific time window.

spec.title: Total Retries
spec.description: Total number of retries happened in the current reindex job.

spec.title: Success Rate by Module
spec.description: Documents successfully indexed per second by module. Graph shows data within dashboard time range - zoom in to see detailed spikes, zoom out to see full job.

spec.title: Failure Rate by Module
spec.description: Failed indexing operations per second by module. Graph shows data within dashboard time range - use to identify when failures occurred.

spec.title: Metadata Workers
spec.description: Throughput per worker instance for metadata indexing. Each line = one worker. Uses dashboard time range to identify slow/stuck workers during specific periods.

spec.title: Content Workers
spec.description: Throughput per worker instance for content indexing. Each line = one worker. Content is typically slower due to ATS transforms. Uses dashboard time range.

spec.title: Path Workers
spec.description: Throughput per worker instance for path indexing. Each line = one worker. Uses dashboard time range to compare worker performance.

spec.title: Maximum time taken for a chunk write across workers
spec.description: Peak single-chunk write time per module, across all workers, for the selected job. For each module (content/metadata/path) this shows the slowest individual chunk-write observed by any worker.

spec.title: Avg Metadata Chunk Write Time per Worker
spec.description: Average time each worker spends writing a successful metadata chunk.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="metadata", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="metadata", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Avg Path Chunk Write Time per Worker
spec.description: Average time each worker spends writing a successful path chunk.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="path", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="path", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Avg Content Chunk Write Time per Worker
spec.description: Average time each worker spends sending a content transform request per chunk. Note: content "write" = publishing the transform request to ActiveMQ, not the actual content indexing.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="content", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="content", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Metadata — Near-Worst-Case Write Time (p95)
spec.description: The slow end of metadata writes per worker — 95% of batches finished at or under this time. Well above the average means occasional slow writes.

spec.title: Path — Near-Worst-Case Write Time (p95)
spec.description: The slow end of path writes per worker — 95% of batches finished at or under this time. Good for spotting a worker with occasional slow writes even when its average looks fine.

spec.title: Content — Near-Worst-Case Write Time (p95)
spec.description: The slow end of content hand-offs per worker — 95% finished at or under this time. This is the request hand-off, not full content indexing, so it's usually the fastest of the three.

spec.title: Metadata - p95 vs avg
spec.description: Average and near-worst-case (p95) metadata write time side by side. A wide gap means uneven writes, close lines mean steady performance.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="metadata", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="metadata", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Path - p95 vs avg
spec.description: Average and near-worst-case (p95) path write time side by side. A wide gap means uneven writes, close lines mean steady performance.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="path", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="path", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Content - p95 vs avg
spec.description: Average and near-worst-case (p95) content hand-off time side by side. A wide gap means uneven hand-offs, close lines mean steady. (Hand-off only, not full content indexing.)

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_sum{module="content", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(alfresco_reindex_chunk_write_duration_seconds_count{module="content", jobId="$jobId"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Job Summary - Uses 'Lookback' variable (NOT dashboard time range)
Processing Statistics - Uses DASHBOARD TIME RANGE (adjust time picker above)
Throughput Graphs - Uses DASHBOARD TIME RANGE (zoom in for detailed view)
Worker Performance - Uses DASHBOARD TIME RANGE (see per-worker throughput)
Write Performance per Chunk - Uses DASHBOARD TIME RANGE
Alfresco Reindex Monitoring

spec.name: jobId
spec.label: Job ID
spec.description: Select which reindex job to monitor. Used by ALL panels in the dashboard.

spec.name: lookback
spec.label: Lookback (Job Summary Only)
spec.description: ONLY affects 'Job Summary' section (Status, Started, Ended, Duration, Age). How far back to search for the selected job's metadata. Increase if viewing old jobs. Does NOT affect other sections.
